title: From a meal plan to one list
description: Adding up the ingredients of the meals you chose, accounting for servings, and seeing where every quantity came from.

blocks.text: Someone picks a few dinners, changes the servings and gets one list. Every line can be expanded to show which meals produced that quantity. If a dinner is called off, exactly its contribution comes off the list.

quote.text: This app is a godsend. I love being able to see a recipe online, upload it into the app, and have the ingredients automatically added to my shopping list.

blocks.text: From a meal to a line

To begin with, a few familiar recipes and ingredient merging you can correct are enough. Eggs counted in units can be added up straight away; different packages and states of a product need to be pinned down. What is left at home counts only once it has been confirmed.

A recalculation you can follow after a meal is swapped is worth more here than a large recipe catalog. This is a natural extension of a meal planner; a standalone app would need a convenient way to bring over the recipes a user has already saved.
